questions.text: Why does the XOR problem need a hidden layer?
options: One neuron can only separate classes with a straight line
questions.explanation: XOR is not linearly separable, so one neuron cannot solve it.

questions.text: A weight on an input is exactly 0. What effect does that input have on z?
questions.explanation: 0 * x = 0, so the input adds nothing to the sum.
